name: night-watch
description: Night Watch scheduled accessibility regression monitor for Haunted Audit.

crons.name: night-watch
crons.prompt: Run the Night Watch nightly journey check: execute `python night_watch/run_journeys.py` in the workspace, capture its JSON output, and if `regressions > 0`, activate the regression-summary agent with the JSON as input. If `regressions == 0`, do not activate the regression-summary agent. Exit immediately after logging the summary. Only spend agent tokens when a regression is detected. Do not open pull requests, do not modify source files, do not push commits. Report only.
